model_output:
To build a Telegram bot with a click-through wizard design, you can use the Telegram Bot API and a web framework such as Flask. Here are the general steps you can follow:
1. Create a new Telegram bot and get its API token.
2. Use the Telegram Bot API to create a new inline bot, which is a bot that can be added to a message as an inline object.
3. Set up your web server and create a new Flask app.
4. Create a new Flask route that will handle incoming requests from Telegram.
5. Use a templating engine such as Jinja2 to generate the HTML content for the wizard.
6. Use JavaScript to create the click-through wizard design and handle user input.
7. Store the user-set parameters in a database or other storage.
8. Use the Telegram Bot API to send the results to the user or to a chatbot that will handle the results.
Keep in mind that this is a high-level overview and you will need to dive deeper into each step to fully understand how to implement it. There are also many resources online that can help you with the implementation of each step.
